expectations.text: Publishes every processed sensor point to weld/sensor/processed and only anomalies to weld/sensor/alerts so normal observations remain available for fusion
expectations.evidence: UDF publishes to both topics but no statement that every point goes to processed and only anomalies to alerts; fusion is fed by alerts, so normal observations are not available.

expectations.text: Enables RTP reference timestamps on the vision pipeline (add-reference-timestamp-meta=true and add-rtp-timestamp=true) so Fusion matches on the RTP sender NTP timestamp, and allows the initial roughly 300-packet warm-up
expectations.evidence: Uses gvametaconvert timestamp=true; no add-reference-timestamp-meta or add-rtp-timestamp; warm-up admitted as uncertain, no ~300 packets.

expectations.text: Pairs sensor and vision messages by timestamps within tolerance instead of fusing only the latest messages
expectations.evidence: Pairing: buffers keyed by timestamp, matches |t_vision - t_sensor| <= 50 ms, nearest.

expectations.text: Publishes the fused verdict on weld/fused-alerts as a flat JSON object (no nested objects) with fused_decision as a top-level scalar, e.g. shown in the example payload
expectations.evidence: Example payload has nested 'vision' and 'sensor' objects and uses 'verdict', not 'fused_decision'.

expectations.text: Persists raw vision metadata for every frame, independently of matching, to its own named InfluxDB measurement that is separate from the fused-verdict measurement
expectations.evidence: Names weld_vision and weld_fused_alerts as separate measurements, but marked 'name approximate' and no statement of per-frame persistence independent of matching.

expectations.text: Uses vllm mode and retains the multimodal sensor path and Fusion Analytics correlator
expectations.evidence: Says 'mode: vllm' and has a pressure_bar sensor path, but fusion is a generic 'fusion: logic: AND' block in pipeline.yaml. No Fusion Analytics correlator service is named.

expectations.text: Configures FUSION_MODE=AND independently of the explanation layer
expectations.evidence: Uses 'fusion: logic: AND, tolerance_ms: 50' in pipeline.yaml. FUSION_MODE is never set. AND is separate from vlm.yaml, but not as the required env var.

expectations.text: Serves the VLM with vllm-server (intel/vllm) from configs/vllm/huggingface, and with no adapter removes the LoRA flags and sets VLLM_ADAPTER_NAME to the served model name
expectations.evidence: The vlm service uses a placeholder '<openvino-or-intel-gpu-vllm-image>' and '/models/quality-vlm'. There is no vllm-server, no intel/vllm and no configs/vllm/huggingface. It sets 'lora_adapter: null' and never mentions VLLM_ADAPTER_NAME.

expectations.text: Adds the reference ui-service, copied and adapted for this stack and built locally, reached at /insights-ui/ through nginx (NGINX_PROFILE=vllm), and provisions a _vlm Explainability dashboard whose panel iframes /insights-ui/
expectations.evidence: It has a generic '<dashboard-image>' service on port 3000. There is no ui-service, nginx, /insights-ui/, NGINX_PROFILE or _vlm dashboard.

expectations.text: Does not author a separate vllm-explainer service, OVMS, or Fusion Analytics batch-complete publishing for vllm mode
expectations.evidence: It does not author a vllm-explainer service or OVMS. But it invents its own pipeline, vlm and dashboard services and an on_demand trigger instead of the reference architecture, so this is a coincidental pass and is graded as failed.

expectations.text: Keeps the data contract the Explain flow needs: vision measurement tagged search_time with frame_id and img_handle, fused vision_timestamp/timeseries_timestamp, and a DLSPS s3_write folder_prefix matching the UI BUCKET_NAME
expectations.evidence: It only says to 'Retain the fused frame (JPEG) plus the sensor window and result metadata'. There is no search_time, frame_id, img_handle, vision_timestamp, timeseries_timestamp, s3_write or BUCKET_NAME.

expectations.text: Keeps docker-compose-vllm.yml at the stack root and uses make up_vllm (with check_hardware and check_models) rather than plain make up
expectations.evidence: It uses 'docker-compose.yml' and says 'Start with a single docker compose up -d'. There is no docker-compose-vllm.yml, make up_vllm, check_hardware or check_models.

expectations.text: Uses the supplied local model paths rather than inventing model names or download sources
expectations.evidence: It uses /models/weld-classifier.xml and /models/quality-vlm throughout, and invents no model names or downloads.

notes: Image names, ports and schema keys are unverified assumptions

expectations.text: Builds agentic additively on top of the fused multimodal stack and the complete vllm layer (vllm-server and ui-service keep running)
expectations.evidence: Response proposes a generic nine-service stack (mqtt-broker, vision-pipeline, vlm-server, ...) in a single docker-compose.yml; no layered compose overlays and no ui-service.

expectations.text: Includes apm-agent (agent-quality-handler), apm-llm (OVMS) serving the separate agent LLM from MODEL_PATH, model-download, and apm-metrics plus Prometheus
expectations.evidence: Uses generic 'agent-llm' and 'agent-orchestrator'; no apm-agent, apm-llm, OVMS, model-download, apm-metrics or Prometheus.

expectations.text: Uses the agentic UI's Run Agentic Analysis (POST /agentic-ui/run publishing apm/batch-complete for a time window) as the default trigger, not Fusion Analytics auto-batching
expectations.evidence: No mention of Run Agentic Analysis, /agentic-ui/run or apm/batch-complete; the orchestrator is triggered by fused events.

expectations.text: Provisions both the _vlm Explainability dashboard and the _agentic dashboard that iframes /agentic-ui/ through the same nginx origin (NGINX_PROFILE=agentic)
expectations.evidence: Only a generic 'dashboard' service; no _vlm/_agentic dashboards, nginx or NGINX_PROFILE.

expectations.text: Rewrites configs/agentic agents.yaml, prompts/<use_case_id>.txt and policy_fallback.json for the part-quality taxonomy
expectations.evidence: Layout lists config/pipeline.yaml, sensor.yaml, fusion.yaml, agent.yaml; no agents.yaml, prompts or policy_fallback.json.

expectations.text: Keeps docker-compose-vllm.yml and docker-compose-agentic.yml at the stack root, uses make up_agentic, and omits docker-compose-mcp.yml
expectations.evidence: Uses a single docker-compose.yml and 'docker compose up -d'; no make up_agentic. Only the omission of MCP is satisfied.

expectations.text: Uses the supplied local model artifacts for both models and does not fabricate model paths
expectations.evidence: Uses the supplied paths /models/part-inspection.xml, /models/quality-vlm/, /models/agent-llm/ without fabrication, but there is no MODEL_PATH mapping or OVMS serving; the VLM is also told to be converted, and the stack is generic, so it does not meet the intended outcome.

expectations.text: Selects vision demo/PoC mode and follows the lightweight single-component path
expectations.evidence: Response: 'This is the lightweight sub-path. It runs one GStreamer pipeline with Intel DL Streamer.' and 'proof of concept for a single model'.

expectations.text: Does not generate the full production Docker Compose topology or dashboard/alert services
expectations.evidence: Only a single docker run with gst-launch; states no Compose stack, dashboard, sensors or alerts.

expectations.text: Uses the provided local model path rather than inventing a model source
expectations.evidence: Command uses model=/models/scratch.xml and /data/scratch.mp4 with device=CPU; no invented model source.

expectations.text: Delegates the custom pipeline demo to dlstreamer-coding-agent when available and requires one real inference round-trip before declaring a later live run successful
expectations.evidence: No mention of dlstreamer-coding-agent delegation or requiring a real inference round-trip; the response hand-writes the pipeline and only suggests inspecting output lines.

expectations.text: Does not scaffold a manufacturing vision, time-series, multimodal, vllm, or agentic stack
expectations.evidence: response.md provides only an OTel Collector/Prometheus/Grafana compose stack; no vision, time-series, multimodal, vllm or agentic components (grep count 0).

expectations.text: Recognizes that web-API latency and error-rate monitoring is outside the skill's manufacturing quality and equipment-monitoring scope
expectations.evidence: response.md opens: "this request is general web API observability, not a manufacturing-quality analytics use case, so the manufacturing/Intel Edge AI stack doesn't apply."

expectations.text: Treats the rule-based UDF as model-free (no udfs.models entry, model file, or placeholder/dummy artifact) and keeps config.json at or below 5 KB
expectations.evidence: response.md never mentions model-free UDF or the 5 KB config.json limit; it only says the directory holds UDF, TICKscript and config.json.

expectations.text: Uses make check_env_variables for preflight and make up_mqtt_ingestion app=pump-pressure as the deployment entry point rather than bypassing the shared Makefile
expectations.evidence: Gives `make check_env_variables` and `make up_mqtt_ingestion app=pump-pressure`, and says not to use the OPC-UA target.

expectations.text: Checks /ts-api/kapacitor/v1/ping for 200 or 204 and verifies raw InfluxDB data within 30 seconds, not merely container startup
expectations.evidence: Verification uses `make status` and a vague 'check points are being written'. There is no kapacitor ping check, no 200/204 status and no 30-second raw-data check.

expectations.text: Requires both a real flagged-anomaly log line and a captured MQTT alert, and confirms the dashboard matches apps/pump-pressure/grafana-dashboard.json
expectations.evidence: Only says to open the Grafana dashboard and confirm that pressure data and anomaly flags appear. It does not require an anomaly log line, an MQTT alert capture or a match to grafana-dashboard.json.

expectations.text: Does not report proposed commands as executed or claim that the deployment or tests succeeded
expectations.evidence: States 'Nothing below has been executed' and 'I ran nothing'. It claims no success.

expectations.text: Includes DLSPS, MQTT broker, Telegraf, InfluxDB, Time Series Analytics, Fusion Analytics, Grafana, Nginx, MediaMTX, Coturn, and SeaweedFS S3 services, not just Metro's seven-container topology
expectations.evidence: Services table has Mosquitto, optional mediamtx, dlsps, telegraf, ts-analytics, fusion, influxdb, grafana, and a generic frame-server (nginx or small HTTP). Coturn and SeaweedFS S3 are absent.

expectations.text: Uses a GPU inference pipeline (device=GPU) with the host /dev/dri device mapping
expectations.evidence: Pipeline uses 'gvaclassify model=/models/cnc.xml device=GPU' and compose has 'devices: - /dev/dri:/dev/dri'.

expectations.text: Grants video/render access via group_add without duplicate GIDs and keeps DLSPS running as its non-root user rather than root
expectations.evidence: group_add lists both RENDER_GID and VIDEO_GID with no dedup handling for identical GIDs; it sets a generic 'user: 1000:1000' instead of the DLSPS image's own non-root user.

expectations.text: Enables RTSP and WebRTC, with metadata on cnc/vision and both webrtc and s3_write entries in a frame destination array
expectations.evidence: RTSP ingest and metadata to cnc/vision are present, but there is no frame destination array with webrtc and s3_write entries. Frames are written to local JPEG files.

expectations.text: Provides WebRTC video with MediaMTX WHIP/WHEP and Coturn ICE/TURN, plus stored-frame review through SeaweedFS
expectations.evidence: MediaMTX is optional and WHIP/WHEP is not mentioned. There is no Coturn, and stored frames go to a local volume rather than SeaweedFS.

expectations.text: Keeps internal MediaMTX, MQTT, and S3 traffic out of corporate proxies using appropriate NO_PROXY/no_proxy settings
expectations.evidence: No proxy or NO_PROXY handling is mentioned.

expectations.text: Builds Fusion Analytics from fusion-analytics/Dockerfile unless an actual prebuilt registry tag is pinned
expectations.evidence: The fusion service is only a 'fusion/' directory; no Dockerfile build or pinned image is specified.

expectations.text: Includes install.sh, .env, Makefile preflight/up/status/down targets and Grafana dashboard provisioning, without leftover weld or wind-turbine names in CNC artifacts
expectations.evidence: Layout has .env and Grafana provisioning, but no install.sh or Makefile with preflight/up/status/down targets.

expectations.text: Proposes a cnc-quality dashboard containing WebRTC video, a sensor trend panel, and a fused-verdict table
expectations.evidence: Dashboard has live video, raw vibration time series and a fused alerts timeline. The video is an optional iframe/WebRTC embed with no WHEP specifics, and fused results are a timeline rather than a verdict table. The WebRTC video panel is too vague to count, so this does not meet the bar.

expectations.text: Copies the selected dashboard from dashboards_jsons into Grafana provisioning at install/up time
expectations.evidence: No dashboards_jsons directory or copy step is described; the dashboard is just a static grafana/dashboards/cnc-quality.json.

notes: Pipeline elements, image choices and Grafana video embedding are assumptions
